name: TravelTime
tagline: Isochrone and time-filter APIs for multi-modal reachability analysis
description: TravelTime provides isochrone, time-filter, and routing APIs that compute travel times and reachable areas by transport mode (driving, public transport, walking, cycling). Developers use it for location intelligence: catchment analysis, site selection, delivery zones, and multi-destination reachability beyond simple point-to-point routing.

auth.details: Application ID and API key via X-Application-Id and X-Api-Key headers; self-serve signup

use_cases: generate isochrones for multi-modal catchment analysis
filter locations by travel time from an origin
compute reachability matrices for many destinations
optimize site selection by drive-time or transit access
build delivery or service-area polygons by travel time
